Agricultural machinery servicing in Victoria

Servicing and heavy diesel support for agricultural machinery across Victoria. Discuss your machine, service history and operating schedule directly with Clive Sampson.

Call Clive · 0474 372 852

Maintenance for your operating schedule

Farm machinery maintenance needs to account for operating hours, service records and the work ahead. Tell Clive which machine needs attention, how it is used and when it can be made available for servicing.

Share the manufacturer service information, any maintenance already due and known faults. If timing is important for seasonal work, raise that when discussing availability.

Useful details for your enquiry

  • Machine make, model, serial number and engine details if available.
  • Current operating hours and service history.
  • Warning messages, starting concerns, leaks, noises or changes in operation.
  • Farm location, nearest town and access arrangements.
  • Your preferred timing and who can approve the work.

Registration details may help for a registered vehicle. For other machinery, the identification plate and machine records can help explain the equipment involved.

Discuss the work and location

Call to discuss planned servicing, a developing fault or a machine that has stopped working. Clive will confirm job suitability, availability and whether field service is appropriate.

Tell Clive about site access, the ground conditions where the machine is located and any restrictions relevant to attendance. Work location, travel and timing are agreed for the actual job.

Component repairs and ongoing maintenance

For a worn or failed assembly, discuss component repair and rebuilding options. Provide the component details and whether it is still fitted or has been removed.

If several machines need attention, see fleet and equipment maintenance. For a location enquiry, use the Victorian suburb and postcode lookup or call with your nearest town.
